pokedexEntries.su: It scatters spores that flicker and glow. Anyone seeing these lights falls into a deep slumber.

pokedexEntries.mo: As it drowses the day away, it nourishes itself by sucking from tree roots. It wakens at the fall of night, wandering off in search of a new tree.

pokedexEntries.us: It scatters its shining spores around itself. Even though they’re dangerous, nighttime tours of forests where Morelull live are popular.

pokedexEntries.um: It likes damp dark places. When night falls, the spores filling the caps of its mushrooms glow.

pokedexEntries.sw: Pokémon living in the forest eat the delicious caps on Morelull’s head. The caps regrow overnight.

pokedexEntries.sh: Morelull live in forests that stay dark even during the day. They scatter flickering spores that put enemies to sleep.
